title: Ecks vs. Sever

widgets.text: Two campaigns: play as Ecks (FBI agent) or Sever (ex-NSA killer). The missions overlap from the two sides of the story; finishing both shows the full plot.
Strafe (L/R) around corners, keep the sniper rifle for long halls and shoot explosive barrels near groups.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text: Each mission has an objective list (reach the exit, rescue, plant charges). Doors with coloured panels need the matching keycard.
Multiplayer deathmatch over link cable (up to 4 players) unlocks no items.
Passwords after each mission; Sever and Ecks campaigns are separate.

notes: RA only maps mission 1 (health/armor/pistol ammo); other missions use other addresses.
